Title: Integration of Azure Backup into the VM creation experience

Body.Content:
You can now configure Azure Backup while you're creating a virtual machine. From the Azure portal, you can:

  • Select a Recovery Services vault (which stores backups) in a different resource group than the virtual machine for access control. 
  • Choose the backup schedule and retention. 

For details, see the Azure Backup blog.
